notes: Tuition: the only figure for this programme is a total 'contributo unico' of 5.500,00€ split over three instalments (2.500,00€ + 1.500,00€ + 1.500,00€); the page does not state it is the fee for a non-EU/international student and does not give an annual fee for such a student, so the amount here is the sum of the year's instalments as shown. No Universitaly mention exists on the supplied pages, so applicationChannel is the university's own MYLUM online procedure; a human should confirm the pre-enrolment route for a Moroccan applicant. Documents: listed on a general 'how to enrol' page (Italian secondary diploma context), not on this programme's own page; 'domanda di immatricolazione in bollo da €16,00' is also listed but is a form, not a supporting document. The 31 October deadline appears with year 2024 for A.A. 2024-2025, so it is recorded as a recurring day/month deadline rather than a fixed date.
